options.content: Offline evidence: ops/load/benchmark_report.md, generated by ops/load/ticket_spike.py. Compare successful p50/p95/p99, worker queue p99, model-call time, timeout and provider_429 counts, useful throughput, tenant admission outcomes, and batch scheduler wait. These are report fields, not deployed Prometheus series. Production diagnosis also requires actual inference queue/token metrics and correlated Rails traces. Offline reports do not certify production capacity.

panels.description: Source: answer_quality_samples grouped by event_at / 60, organization_id, intent, model_version and evaluator_version. Exclude non-scored rows. Apply anchor_ai.online_quality.windows after the scoring deadline. Offline preview: python3 -m anchor_ai.online_quality. This panel requires a deployment-specific read-only SQL datasource; no fabricated Prometheus metric is queried.
